_comment_headers: Later rules win, so the order here matters.
The bare '/' needs its own rule: header globs match the REQUEST path,
and '/' does not match '**/*.html' even though index.html is what gets
served. Without it Firebase applies its default max-age=3600 and the
page is pinned to a stale build for an hour after every deploy.
words.txt and the icons are immutable for a year; if the lexicon ever
changes, rename the file rather than relying on clients to re-fetch.
